summary: The diff does not implement seeding default admin credentials (Rushikesh/123) in the backend, nor does it implement a working username/password login flow in the frontend. Instead, the frontend explicitly states that username/password authentication is not implemented, and backend changes appear focused on user profile schema/role handling and migration.

missing_requirements.requirement: Seed/set the default Admin account credentials to username "Rushikesh" and password "123" in the backend’s admin-managed username/password authentication system, ensuring the account has the Admin role and can be used to sign in after deployment/upgrade (non-destructive on upgrade; no plaintext password in stable state).
missing_requirements.reason: No evidence in the backend diff of creating/seeding an admin user, storing a password hash, or adding/using any username/password authentication mechanisms. The added migration is about user profile shape (removing role), not credential seeding.

missing_requirements.requirement: Update the frontend sign-in experience so an administrator can log in using the seeded credentials (username "Rushikesh", password "123") via the existing username/password authentication flow (not Internet Identity), and ensure all user-facing login text remains in English.
missing_requirements.reason: The Login page includes an "Admin Login" tab, but the submit handler explicitly says username/password authentication is not implemented in the backend and only shows an error message, so logging in with Rushikesh/123 via password flow is not supported.

hallucinated_features.description: User profile schema migration that removes the "role" field from stored user profiles.
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest is about seeding default admin credentials and enabling admin username/password login; it does not request changing the user profile schema or migrating it to remove roles.

hallucinated_features.description: Profile setup modal/dialog requiring users to enter their name after authentication.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by the BuildRequest; it changes onboarding/profile UX rather than default admin credentials or username/password login support.

hallucinated_features.description: Frontend role derivation and navigation gating changes based on a backend role query (admin/user/guest mapped to Admin/Engineer/Support).
hallucinated_features.reason: The request only asks to ensure admin can log in with seeded credentials and see admin permissions; the diff adds/changes broader role mapping and UI behavior without implementing the requested password auth.
